name: toml
title: TOML
description: TOML write, read, nested, encoding, and JSON conversion for Lyo.Toml over a flat 7-column SampleRecord (int/string/decimal/bool/DateTime). Write covers bytes, string, stream, file, async, and a pre-sized span. Read covers the same sources. Encoding compares UTF-8, UTF-16, and UTF-32. NestedRecord round-trips a depth-2 address. RowCount is the number of records.
